session.description: A QUIC client on an Earth site reaches a QUIC server on the lunar surface through LEO access, a LEO-to-GEO crosslink, the cislunar relay hop, and the lunar relay constellation. Endpoint hosts run no routing daemon; the FRR-routed nodes carry the path.
session.name: earth-luna-quic
